meaning: May express annoyance, or request an introduction/recommendation in “put me on”.
caution: May be vulgar or insulting. Explained neutrally; no abusive reply is suggested. Ask for context.

full: An aggressive request to stop talking
meaning: A vulgar command telling someone to be quiet.
caution: May be vulgar or insulting. Explained neutrally; no abusive reply is suggested. Ask for context.

meaning: An insulting initialism that aggressively tells someone to stop speaking.
caution: May be vulgar or insulting. Explained neutrally; no abusive reply is suggested. Ask for context.

meaning: In some online messages this is shorthand for “this” or a vulgar “this stuff”; other communities use other expansions.
caution: May be vulgar or insulting. Explained neutrally; no abusive reply is suggested. Ask for context.

meaning: A vulgar expression of surprise, confusion, or frustration.
caution: May be vulgar or insulting. Explained neutrally; no abusive reply is suggested. Ask for context.

meaning: Often affection, appreciation, or support; not proof of romantic intent.
caution: Official name and search keywords are not a universal emotional interpretation. No secret or romantic meaning is inferred.
example: Thank you ❤️

meaning: May signal interest, curiosity, or noticing something.
caution: Official name and search keywords are not a universal emotional interpretation. No secret or romantic meaning is inferred.
example: New announcement 👀

meaning: May praise something as excellent or exciting; can also mean literal fire.
caution: Official name and search keywords are not a universal emotional interpretation. No secret or romantic meaning is inferred.
example: That performance was 🔥

meaning: Often laughter; can also be sarcastic.
caution: Official name and search keywords are not a universal emotional interpretation. No secret or romantic meaning is inferred.
example: That joke 😂

meaning: May signal agreement, cooperation, or acknowledgment.
caution: Official name and search keywords are not a universal emotional interpretation. No secret or romantic meaning is inferred.
example: Deal 🤝

meaning: Can mean a lie in some chats, or simply represent a cap.
caution: Official name and search keywords are not a universal emotional interpretation. No secret or romantic meaning is inferred.
example: No 🧢

meaning: May express embarrassment, overwhelm, or playful resignation.
caution: Official name and search keywords are not a universal emotional interpretation. No secret or romantic meaning is inferred.
example: Another deadline 🫠

meaning: May express affection, thanks, or support.
caution: Official name and search keywords are not a universal emotional interpretation. No secret or romantic meaning is inferred.
example: Thanks for helping 🫶

meaning: One common number-code meaning counts letters in I / love / you.
caution: Not a universal numeric code; could just be a number.

senses.definition: I love you

meaning: A phonetic number-and-letter spelling of today.
example: See you 2day.
caution: Informal spelling.

meaning: Agreement or acknowledgment in many casual exchanges.
example: Meet at six? Bet.
caution: Can also refer to an actual wager.

meaning: The sender expects to return soon.
example: BRB, grabbing water.
caution: Soon is not a precise duration.

senses.definition: Be right back
The state of being away from one's device while meaning to come back soon.

meaning: A casual reaction to surprise, disbelief, or frustration.
example: Bruh, I missed the bus.
caution: Can sound dismissive or familiar.

meaning: Asks or states when something or someone may arrive.
example: What’s your ETA?
caution: May refer to task completion in some workplaces.

senses.definition: Estimated time of arrival

meaning: Introduces information that may be useful.
example: FYI, the meeting moved.
caution: Tone depends on surrounding text.

senses.definition: For your information

meaning: The sender does not know or is unsure.
example: IDK when the lecture starts.
caution: Can sound dismissive depending on context.

senses.definition: I don’t know

meaning: Marks a personal opinion.
example: IMO, we should start early.
caution: Opinion rather than verified fact.

senses.definition: In my opinion

meaning: Something seems questionable or suspicious.
example: That move was sus.
caution: Does not prove wrongdoing.

senses.definition: To suspend an account on social media (almost exclusively Twitter/X).

A nonsense word commonly used in YouTube Poop by playing an audio clip forward and in reverse consecutively; said in reference to this editing style, and to describe palindromes and humorously symmetrized images.

meaning: Introduces an honest opinion.
example: TBH, that lecture was helpful.
caution: Honesty does not guarantee a statement is accurate.

senses.definition: To be honest

meaning: Acknowledgment or agreement in Roman Urdu.
example: Theek hai, kal milte hain.
caution: Can convey resignation depending on tone.

meaning: The sender plans to end this exchange for now.
example: Busy rn, ttyl.
caution: Does not promise a specific time.

senses.definition: Talk to you later

meaning: A short spelling of you.
example: Are u coming?
caution: Avoid in formal writing.

senses.definition: You

meaning: A shortened word for university.
example: Heading to uni.
caution: Not exclusive to any one region.

meaning: A familiar form of address or expressive conversational word.
example: Yaar, assignment reh gayi.
reply: Koi baat nahi, mil kar karte hain.
caution: Familiarity and appropriateness vary by relationship.

meaning: An Urdu expression whose use depends on context.
example: اچھا، پھر ملتے ہیں۔
caution: Can signal acknowledgment, surprise, or evaluation.

meaning: Often conveys figurative laughter or shock online.
example: That joke 💀
caution: Can also be literal; context is essential.

senses.definition: Standard Unicode/CLDR name: skull. This label identifies the symbol; chat intent depends on the surrounding message.

meaning: May convey sadness, laughter, overwhelm, or a dramatic reaction.
example: That video is so funny 😭
caution: Surrounding words matter; no single guaranteed emotion.

senses.definition: Standard Unicode/CLDR name: loudly crying face. This label identifies the symbol; chat intent depends on the surrounding message.

meaning: May suggest irony, awkwardness, or playful frustration.
example: Another deadline 🙃
caution: Could be passive-aggressive; do not assume.

senses.definition: Standard Unicode/CLDR name: upside-down face. This label identifies the symbol; chat intent depends on the surrounding message.

meaning: May acknowledge a request or convey respect.
example: On it 🫡
caution: Can be playful or ironic.
